instrument_name: DLocal Limited Class A common shares
watchlist_reason: Q2 growth, cash conversion and raised guidance remain constructive, but the mark has exited the buy zone, payoff gates weakened, and take-rate compression, concentration, new debt capacity and the absent accepted relationship require monitoring.
